items.title: Rick Montalbano interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 12, 2011
items.q: Do you know that Bucky Pizzarelli played on “How Much is that Doggy in the Window?”

ctx.x: In the window? All right Angelina. It’s somewhere buried in here. Sorry about that.
Do you know that Bucky Pizzarelli played on “How Much is that Doggy in the Window?”
That doesn’t surprise me. Is that okay to put that there?
